description: This file contains implementation of decomposition passes for TorchScript JIT, including functions for decomposing normalization operations and other tensor operations, as well as registration of custom operators.

methods.name: aliasAnalysisFromSchema
methods.description: Returns alias analysis kind from schema, used for operator registration.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks if a tensor argument/value is statically defined (not None or Optional[Tensor]).

methods.name: isDecomposableNorm
methods.description: Determines if a normalization node (batch_norm or layer_norm) can be decomposed based on device and input properties.

methods.name: reg_ops
methods.description: Registers custom operators _ncf_unsqueeze and _ncf_view for internal tensor manipulations.

methods.name: DecomposeOps
methods.description: Recursively decomposes specific tensor operations in a graph, such as addmm, batch_norm, and layer_norm, replacing them with simpler subgraphs.

methods.name: DecomposeOps (overload)
methods.description: Main entry point that runs decomposition on a graph, then propagates shapes, propagates constants, and eliminates dead code if decomposition occurs.
